title: Linen Everyday Shirt
author: ThreadCraft Store
body: Customer reviews and business replies for the Linen Everyday Shirt.

comments.author: Morgan Reed
comments.text: Really comfortable fabric and a good fit. I have already ordered another color.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thanks, Morgan! We are glad you like the shirt. 😊

replies.author: Morgan Reed
replies.text: I ordered the blue one too. I usually wear a medium; would you keep the same size?

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: The blue shirt has the same cut. If your first medium feels comfortable through the shoulders, we recommend staying with it.

replies.author: Morgan Reed
replies.text: That sounds right. The shoulders fit well and I have room to move without the body feeling oversized.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: That is the fit we designed for. For care, a cool wash and a low tumble or air dry will help preserve the linen texture.

replies.author: Morgan Reed
replies.text: I washed the first one cold and hung it overnight. It softened up and did not noticeably shrink.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We appreciate the care update, Morgan. We will pass your fit notes to the product team.

comments.author: Taylor Brooks
comments.text: Looks great. The sleeves are a little long for me, but the quality is excellent.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thank you for the detailed feedback. The cuff can be rolled once without adding bulk, and we have shared your sleeve note with our fit team.

comments.author: Casey Rivera
comments.text: Lightweight and breathable. I wore it on a warm walk and stayed comfortable all afternoon.

comments.author: Jamie Wilson
comments.text: The natural color is exactly as pictured, and the linen has a nice weight without feeling stiff.

comments.author: Mina Lopez
comments.text: The natural color is exactly as pictured, and the garment-washed linen feels soft from the first wear.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We are happy the natural shade worked for you. Thanks for mentioning the soft finish.

comments.author: Riley Thompson
comments.text: The linen has enough weight to hang well without feeling heavy. I wore it through a long workday and stayed comfortable.

comments.author: Riley Thompson
comments.text: The collar arrived creased from shipping, but a quick steam took care of it. The rest of the shirt looks great.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Linen can crease in transit. We are reviewing how the shirts are folded in the mailer.

comments.author: Avery Patel
comments.text: I sized down based on the chart and the fit is neat without pulling at the buttons. The measurements were accurate.

comments.author: Logan Brooks
comments.text: The white color is clean and easy to style. I would have liked a note on the product page about wearing a base layer in direct sun.

comments.author: Logan Brooks
comments.text: The white linen is comfortable, but more transparent in bright sunlight than I expected.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We appreciate the honest note and will make the fabric opacity clearer in the product details.

comments.author: Harper Green
comments.text: Wore it to work with chinos and got two compliments. It looks polished even when I leave it untucked.

comments.author: Elliot Moore
comments.text: The medium fits comfortably across my chest and shoulders, with enough room to layer a light tee underneath.

comments.author: Elliot Moore
comments.text: The medium fits my chest and shoulders, though I wish the body were about an inch shorter.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thanks for sharing your proportions and fit preference. We are collecting feedback on shirt length for our next pattern review.

comments.author: Skylar Davis
comments.text: The parcel arrived two days earlier than the estimate, and the shirt was packed in recyclable paper.

comments.author: Parker Young
comments.text: Comfortable in humid weather and easy to layer under a light jacket. The buttons feel secure.

comments.author: Quinn Baker
comments.text: The blue shirt is soft straight out of the package. The buttons are secure and the seams look neatly finished.

comments.author: Quinn Parker
comments.text: The blue is a little brighter than my monitor showed, but it is a lovely color in person.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Screens can shift color slightly. We are adding daylight photos of the blue shade so customers can compare it more easily.

comments.author: Emerson Hall
comments.text: I followed the wash label and air-dried the shirt. It kept its shape and feels even softer now.

comments.author: Rowan Scott
comments.text: The fabric and stitching are excellent. I would prefer one extra button near the bottom when wearing the shirt untucked.

comments.author: Rowan Scott
comments.text: Good everyday shirt, but the first button sits a little high for how I like to wear an open collar.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thanks for the collar feedback. We will include that in the next sample review with our garment team.

comments.author: Finley Adams
comments.text: I bought this for a beach trip. It packed small, dried quickly, and did not feel clammy after a long day outside.

comments.author: Dakota Lewis
comments.text: The size chart was accurate once I measured my shoulders. The shirt drapes nicely and does not pull when I reach forward.

comments.author: Dakota Lewis
comments.text: The small was too narrow across my back, but exchanging for a medium was straightforward and free.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We are glad the exchange was easy. Our fit guide includes a shoulder measurement to help with future orders.

comments.author: Reese Carter
comments.text: The stitching is tidy and there were no loose threads. It feels like a shirt I will keep wearing for years.

comments.author: Alex Morgan
comments.text: I like the relaxed cut, but the cuffs are snug when I roll the sleeves. Unbuttoning the cuff makes them comfortable.

comments.author: Blake Turner
comments.text: The olive shade is understated and looks good with navy trousers. The relaxed shape works well untucked.

comments.author: Blake Turner
comments.text: I took the olive shirt on a weekend trip. It paired easily with jeans and stayed comfortable in the heat.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Olive has become a favorite for travel. Thank you for describing how it worked for your trip.

comments.author: Cameron Price
comments.text: I had a question about care before washing and support answered with clear instructions the same afternoon.

comments.author: Cameron Price
comments.text: One button was sewn loosely on arrival. Support sent a replacement button kit the same afternoon.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We are sorry about the loose button and have flagged the batch for an extra button check.

comments.author: Drew Phillips
comments.text: The fabric has natural slubs that make each shirt look a little different. That texture is exactly what I wanted.

comments.author: Kendall Ward
comments.text: The natural texture makes the shirt look relaxed without being sloppy. It pairs easily with both jeans and work trousers.

comments.author: Kendall Ward
comments.text: I prefer the relaxed linen look and now just steam the shirt briefly instead of ironing it flat.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: A light steam smooths the bigger folds while keeping the linen texture. Thanks for the care tip.

comments.author: Arden Bailey
comments.text: I am between sizes and chose the larger one. It drapes nicely, especially tucked into high-waisted trousers.

comments.author: Sydney Cooper
comments.text: The shirt fits well, but the fabric felt rougher than expected before the first wash. It softened after washing.

comments.author: Sydney Cooper
comments.text: Tracking did not update for four days, although the shirt arrived in good condition once the parcel moved.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We are sorry the tracking was quiet. We shared the carrier delay with our shipping team and are glad the parcel arrived safely.

comments.author: Remy Collins
comments.text: The natural shirt works with almost everything in my closet. The pocket is useful without making the front look busy.

comments.author: Charlie Bell
comments.text: The fabric weight is ideal for warm weather, and after a few wears it has softened without losing its shape.

comments.author: Charlie Bell
comments.text: The fit is roomy at the waist. I would love a slim option, but the quality and finish are very good.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We currently offer the relaxed cut and have passed your request for another fit to the design team.

comments.author: Frankie Rivera
comments.text: Bought one for my partner and ended up ordering one for myself. The fabric is cool without feeling delicate.

comments.author: Robin Murphy
comments.text: The white shirt looks crisp with a blazer and the relaxed cut gives enough room at the shoulders.

comments.author: Robin Murphy
comments.text: The white shirt is a staple, but I wear a light undershirt because it is a little sheer in direct sun.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We appreciate the practical note. We will make the white fabric photos less studio-lit so the weight is easier to judge.

comments.author: Jules Bennett
comments.text: The package included a handwritten thank-you card. Small touch, but it made the order feel thoughtful.

comments.author: Eden Morris
comments.text: After three washes the seams are straight and the color has not faded. I use the gentle cycle and hang it to dry.

comments.author: Kai Robinson
comments.text: The inside seams lie flat and do not rub, even after wearing the shirt all day in warm weather.

comments.author: Kai Robinson
comments.text: I wish the care label were printed on softer material. The shirt itself is comfortable against my skin.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thank you for pointing out the label. We are reviewing a softer printed label for the next production run.

comments.author: Marley Cook
comments.text: I wore it through a full travel day and it stayed breathable. The wrinkles looked intentional by dinner.

comments.author: Shiloh Reed
comments.text: The shirt washed well on a cool cycle and air-dried overnight with no visible shrinkage.

comments.author: Shiloh Reed
comments.text: The small fits well in the shoulders, though the sleeves are a touch short when I reach forward.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We appreciate the sleeve feedback. Our fit team would be glad to compare your usual sleeve length with the pattern.

comments.author: Tatum Gray
comments.text: The exchange process was simple when I needed to go up a size. The replacement arrived with a prepaid return label.

comments.author: Payton Flores
comments.text: The charcoal color is a good alternative to black and looks smart without feeling formal.

comments.author: Payton Flores
comments.text: Nice fabric and color, but the chest pocket sits slightly high on my frame. Otherwise a dependable summer shirt.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thanks for the pocket placement note. We will add it to the pattern feedback alongside sleeve and length requests.

comments.author: Micah Sanders
comments.text: I ordered the charcoal shade for a casual wedding. It looked sharp with a jacket and stayed comfortable outdoors.

comments.author: Lennon Hughes
comments.text: The collar keeps its shape after washing and the front placket lies flat when buttoned.

comments.author: Lennon Hughes
comments.text: The shirt arrived with a faint crease line from the packaging, but it disappeared after the first wash.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: We are glad the first wash removed the crease. We are testing a flatter fold to reduce marks during transit.

comments.author: Dallas Perry
comments.text: The buttons have a nice matte finish and match the natural fabric. Nothing feels flimsy or overly shiny.

comments.author: Indigo Bailey
comments.text: The support team answered my sizing question before I ordered, so I got the right fit on the first try.

comments.author: Indigo Bailey
comments.text: I chose the wrong size from the chart and support helped me swap it before the order shipped.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Happy we caught the size change in time. Thanks for reaching out before dispatch.

comments.author: Sage Mitchell
comments.text: I have sensitive skin and find the softened linen comfortable all day. The inside seams are finished smoothly.

comments.author: River Hayes
comments.text: A little expensive for a single shirt, but the stitching, fabric, and customer service have made it worth keeping.

comments.author: Jaden Perez
comments.text: Thoughtful packaging, responsive support, and linen that feels better each time I wear it. I am pleased with this purchase.

replies.author: ThreadCraft Store
replies.text: Thank you for choosing ThreadCraft. We appreciate you sharing your experience and hope you enjoy the shirt for years.
